row.notes: F1WorldActivityContainerViewModel builds its 7 tab VMs (ctor 0x1414bdac0 with the template name and the lng title) into the vector at vm+0x2c8, in this order: f1_world_activity (lng_f1_world_play), f1_world_activity_offline (lng_f1_world_play_offline), dynamic_era_select (lng_solo_grand_prix), public_gp_select (lng_public_grand_prix), dynamic_era_select (lng_time_trial), dynamic_era_select (lng_screen_era_select), session_create_dlc_select_tab (lng_create_session_dlc_select; template registered by f1_world_container.ui). No tab instantiates time_trial_select, which f1_world_activity_container.ui also registers (correction 2026-10-23: an earlier note listed it in place of session_create_dlc_select_tab). The UITC instantiates each tab template by name (Vm_UiTabs_OnMessage). Runtime-observed 2026-10-23 with re/tools/ui_trace (gdb, breaking and fixed era builds; logs not filed as a T### run, so not L3): the content loop built exactly these seven templates in this order. docs/reference/ui/engine.md
